record.question: A Government servant takes an administrative decision mainly to benefit a close friend, though the decision is otherwise within his formal powers. Under the CCS (Conduct) Rules, this is:
options: permissible because the order is within jurisdiction
permissible if Government suffers no direct financial loss
improper because he must not misuse his position to derive benefit for himself, family or friends
improper only if the friend is a government contractor
